'''Ultimate Conflict''' is the third of four releases of [[Virtual Block 7]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 3 June 2011.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 43 cards: 21 Dark Side and 22 Light Side.

== Discrepancies ==
* Printed as IG Bodyguard Droid; later released as [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json DarkLegacy.json] (swccg-card-json legacy card data). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020183346/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/d4e661ec735dcb111266fbda98704f2181e1cfab/DarkLegacy.json Internet Archive].</ref>
* Printed as Spice Mine Administrator; later released as [[Moruth Doole, Kessel Administrator]].<ref name="pdf" /><ref name="dl" />

Once per turn, if you control Extraction Facility, may place a 'spice' card in owner's Lost Pile to draw up to 2 cards from Reserve Deck. Once during your turn, may: use 2 Force to stack a card from Lost Pile here, deploy a non-character card with 'Kessel' in title, and/or 'mine' (opponent draws destiny; draw up to X destiny, where X = 1 plus number of Kessel locations you occupy; if any of the printed destiny numbers match, stack opponent's destiny or top card of your Lost Pile here).
